mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review ( review_no, member_no, product_no, order_item_no, title, content, rating, user_height, user_weight, size_rating, image_url ) VALUES ( seq_review.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{productNo}, #{orderItemNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{userHeight}, #{userWeight}, #{sizeRating}, #{imageUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT review_no AS reviewNo, member_no AS memberNo, product_no AS productNo, order_item_no AS orderItemNo, title, content, rating, user_height AS userHeight, user_weight AS userWeight, size_rating AS sizeRating, image_url AS imageUrl, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM review WHERE product_no = #{productNo} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT review_no AS reviewNo, member_no AS memberNo, product_no AS productNo, order_item_no AS orderItemNo, title, content, rating, user_height AS userHeight, user_weight AS userWeight, size_rating AS sizeRating, image_url AS imageUrl, like_count AS likeCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM review WHERE review_no = #{reviewNo}
SELECT review_no AS reviewNo, order_item_no AS orderItemNo, product_no AS productNo FROM review WHERE order_item_no = #{orderItemNo} AND delete_yn = 'N'
